name: Regional fulfillment
prompt: Regional fulfillment: on-time delivery rate by region, shipment volume by region, and average delay days by region.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  region,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 1) AS on_time_rate
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY on_time_rate DESC, region

copy.title: On-time delivery by region
copy.caption: Latin America and North America deliver 100% on time, while Europe lags at just 28%.

binding.sql:
SELECT region AS region, COUNT(shipment_id) AS shipment_volume
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE dispatched BETWEEN CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE) AND CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY shipment_volume DESC, region

copy.title: Regional shipment volume
copy.caption: Shipment volume is balanced across regions at roughly 168 shipments each.

binding.sql:
SELECT region AS region, ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 1) AS avg_delay_days
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delay_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC, region

copy.title: Delay by region
copy.caption: Europe averages 3.5 days late; every other region delivers on or ahead of schedule.
